name: Greater Channel Spirit (Mythic)
body:
Your mythic nature deepens even more your bond with the spirits.

Prerequisite(s): Greater Channel Spirit.

Benefit(s): You gain one of the following feats, or the mythic version of a feat you already possessed: Absorb Spirit, Fortune Teller, Free Spirit, Improved Legendary Influence, Incorporeal Intuition, Legendary Influence, Spirit Ally, Spirit Beacon, Spirit Focus, Spirit Rebuke, Spirit Ridden, Spirit Sense, Spirit Sight, Spirit Speaker, Spirit Vision. You can’t gain a feat that relies on a class feature you don’t possess. In addition, In addition, you treat your character level as your medium level for any intermediate or greater powers you gain from the Greater Channel Spirit feat.
